origins.section: A Prediction Describes the Future Without You; a Prescription Chooses What You Do
Ranking by Risk Is Not a Plan
Predictions Enter the Model as Coefficients, and Their Errors Travel With Them

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-rul: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.pass:q-rul: page reader (independent agent; saw the lesson pages and the question)
recorded.outcome:q-rul: PoF_next is "the chance the asset fails next year, given that it is working today"; A004: "an RUL of 1 year, yet a PoF of only 3.4% next year. RUL and PoF come from different questions ... and they do not have to agree."
recorded.prompt:q-ranking: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.pass:q-ranking: page reader (independent agent; saw the lesson pages and the question)
recorded.outcome:q-ranking: "The risk ranking funds both the replacement and the repair of the same transformer (P006 and P007), which counts the same risk twice, and it drops the must-do P002. Its 674.0 looks better than the optimized 436.3 only because it is not a plan the utility can carry out."
recorded.prompt:q-error: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.pass:q-error: page reader (independent agent; saw the lesson pages and the question)
recorded.outcome:q-error: "Scale every distribution asset's PoF and solve again ... not 'is the model accurate?' but 'is it accurate enough for this decision?'"

gates.says: all 9 of this quiz's discriminating readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-rul:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.pass:q-rul:a: page reader (independent agent; saw the lesson pages and the question)
recorded.outcome:q-rul:a: PoF is defined for the next year ("Probability it fails in the coming year"), not over the RUL; RUL comes "from the predictive model, separately".
recorded.prompt:q-rul:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.pass:q-rul:c: page reader (independent agent; saw the lesson pages and the question)
recorded.outcome:q-rul:c: "RUL and PoF come from different questions (when is the asset 'used up' ...) and they do not have to agree. A planner who reads 'RUL 1' as 'fails next year' overstates the urgency"
recorded.prompt:q-rul:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.pass:q-rul:d: page reader (independent agent; saw the lesson pages and the question)
recorded.outcome:q-rul:d: Same A004 passage: reading a short RUL as imminent failure overstates the urgency; the PoF next year here is 4%.
recorded.prompt:q-ranking:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.pass:q-ranking:a: page reader (independent agent; saw the lesson pages and the question)
recorded.outcome:q-ranking:a: "looks better than the optimized 436.3 only because it is not a plan the utility can carry out"; both use the same prediction coefficients ("the prediction gives you the coefficients ... The optimization gives you the decision").
recorded.prompt:q-ranking:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.pass:q-ranking:c: page reader (independent agent; saw the lesson pages and the question)
recorded.outcome:q-ranking:c: The optimized plan comes from searching "every plan for the one that removes the most risk within the rules", and the gap exists "only because it [the ranking] is not a plan the utility can carry out".
recorded.prompt:q-ranking:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.pass:q-ranking:d: page reader (independent agent; saw the lesson pages and the question)
recorded.outcome:q-ranking:d: The model's objective is max sum a_i x_i, the risk avoided ("The plan that removes the most risk ..."), and the gap is "only because" the ranking's plan is infeasible.
recorded.prompt:q-error:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.pass:q-error:a: page reader (independent agent; saw the lesson pages and the question)
recorded.outcome:q-error:a: "That is the answer the director needs about the analytics model: not 'is the model accurate?' but 'is it accurate enough for this decision?'"
recorded.prompt:q-error:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.pass:q-error:b: page reader (independent agent; saw the lesson pages and the question)
recorded.outcome:q-error:b: The page re-solves at each scale ("Scale ... and solve again") and shows the plan can change (x0.3); keeping the plan without re-solving is not the check.
recorded.prompt:q-error:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.pass:q-error:c: page reader (independent agent; saw the lesson pages and the question)
recorded.outcome:q-error:c: "RUL and PoF come from different questions ... and they do not have to agree" - agreement is not a test of accuracy.
